about.title: About me
paragraphs: I'm a Data Engineer I at EDS with a degree in Information Systems. I have experience in data engineering, software development and enterprise systems integration.
I develop ETL/ELT pipelines, model and transform data, and optimize relational databases. I also work on back-end services, web interfaces and application deployment.

experience.title: Professional experience
experience.summary: Data engineering and enterprise software development, with responsibilities in databases, back-end services, web interfaces and application deployment.

areas.title: Pipelines and data transformation
areas.description: Development and maintenance of ETL/ELT pipelines, processing of large data volumes, and organization of data architectures into Bronze, Silver and Gold layers.

areas.title: Integration and data quality
areas.description: Integration of data from different systems, with incremental loading, validation and record deduplication.

areas.title: Databases and performance
areas.description: Development and optimization of SQL queries and PL/SQL procedures, using materialized views to optimize and provide access to data in Oracle and PostgreSQL databases.

areas.title: Orchestration and traceability
areas.description: Pipeline orchestration with Apache Airflow, execution monitoring, error handling and implementation of traceability mechanisms.

areas.title: Software development
areas.description: Development and maintenance of web applications with Vue.js, JavaScript and UI frameworks, alongside back-end services with Java, Quarkus and Hibernate Reactive. Integration of applications, APIs and relational databases, with use of Docker.
